name: sme-row-panel-pack
hypothesis: Pack one 2VL-row panel of A into contiguous k-major vectors, then reuse it across all column blocks before packing the next panel. This retains the baseline's transpose work but reduces scratch space from n*n to n*2VL floats and replaces n-stride A loads with sequential panel loads. The expected gain is lower cache and address-generation cost; the supplied timing variation means this gain must be confirmed across repeats.
